💷 THE STATE PENSION IS ABOUT TO BE TAXED.

The earnings figure for the triple lock is in at 3.9%. That puts the full new state pension on course for £250.70 a week from April 2027 — £13,036.40 a year. 📈

The personal allowance? Frozen at £12,570. 🧊

This year there was £22.40 of headroom. Next April there's £466.40 of taxable income — a little over £93 of income tax arising on a state pension, for people whose only income IS the state pension the government sets.

❗ Nobody voted for this. No minister announced it. It was done by freezing a threshold and waiting.

The state pension isn't a handout — it's a contributory entitlement paid for out of a lifetime of National Insurance on money already taxed once.

🗓️ John Healey's first Budget is 28 October. He can lift the allowance, exempt the state pension, or say nothing and bank the money. Watch which he picks.
